mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals the Federal Reserve's shift to an easing stance, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuation multiples, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the 3-month US Treasury yield above 4.5% triggers a flight to quality in equities, compressing discount rates and pushing forward returns negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-yield periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to raise capital expenditures and expand earnings forecasts, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.5% for 3 consecutive months triggers a wage-price spiral, accelerating inflation and prompting preemptive rate hikes, which compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
